Report on the `targets` pipeline used for data analysis.

# Todo:
- [ ] Move pointblank to targets workflow

@tbl-tar-meta flag any errors or warnings from target items.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tar-meta
library(targets)
library(DT)
tar_meta <- tar_meta()
tar_meta |>
  select(name, seconds, warnings, error) |>
  mutate(
    flagged = case_when(
      !is.na(warnings) | !is.na(error) ~ TRUE,
      .default = FALSE
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(flagged)) |>
  datatable()
```

@tbl-tar-timing shows the slowest elements of the pipeline.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tar-timing

tar_meta |>
  select(name, seconds, warnings, error) |>
  arrange(desc(seconds)) |>
  datatable()
```

Finally, we'd like to get an oversight of the size of all our table objects.


```{r}
#| label: tbl-tar-tables

tar_load_everything()
```
